verdict.rationale: Docs and API show natural-language-to-app generation, full-stack scaffolding, backend/database integrations, and one-click deployment (v0-docs-15, v0-docs-24, v0-docs-28, v0-docs-32, v0-gh-1). A first-hand community report confirms a working MVP built and deployed quickly from a prompt (v0-comm-1). Missing for 10: broader independent benchmarking on complex, non-trivial apps and evidence addressing the noted design-sameness limitation (v0-comm-4).
